cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Hand It Over
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to give up control of a task, object, or decision you believe is being mishandled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've circled two names together, so I've circled the exes. They shouldn't share a table. Give me the seating-plan pencil.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Those circles mean food allergies, not couples. The exes aren't together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, food first. I'll put them at separate tables with their own meals clearly marked.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already done that. This took me hours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let me check each table against your list. You can keep the list; give me the pencil and I'll make any changes on the plan.
